Nagaland University Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Nagaland University Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Nagaland University recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Nagaland University recruitment is Project Associate - I. This is a project-based role within the research field.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate - I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate (PG) degree in Science with a NET qualification. Knowledge of Hydrological Modelling, Remote Sensing, and GIS is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 01 September 2026 at 11:00 a.m.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview take place?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted in the Department of Environmental Science, Nagaland University, Lumami, Nagaland - 798627.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents supporting their educational qualifications and experiences, along with a set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit mentioned for this post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any age-related criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NU/EVS/Gen-1/F-6/2016-184.
